text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ecthyma Gangrenosum secondary to Pseudomonas bacteremia (likely due to underlying Crohn's disease and diabetes, mimicking cellulitis). The history of an initial bite followed by rapid progression to an ulcer, combined with your immunocompromised state, strongly suggests a vascular necrotic infection rather than simple cellulitis. We need blood cultures and a full metabolic panel to confirm sepsis and guide antibiotic selection immediately.
